object.attr: stakeholder: each reason has a different fix: clone the repository, open its root, run git fetch --unshallow, or clone to a local disk. The refusals of partial clones and sparse checkouts are Proposed and carry their own reasons.
object.description: When Mellon refuses the folder Mellon was asked to open, Mellon shall report whether the folder is outside a git work tree, a subfolder of one, a shallow clone, or a repository git can't open.
